headline: DeepSeek hits 25.7% as Zhipu AI's GLM breaks its own record
summary: DeepSeek's dominance deepened with a 1.4-point jump to 25.7% provider share, while its flagship v4-flash model (15.0%) continues to set the pace. Zhipu AI's freshly-minted GLM 5.3 crashed the top 25 at rank 22 with an all-time token-share high of 0.9%, and Anthropic's Claude 4.7 Opus staged a dramatic 19-rank leap to #25. On the flip side, OpenAI shed 1.5 points to 10.4%, and Google's Gemini 3.6 Flash vaulted 11 spots in a single day despite a brutal 17-rank tumble over the week.
highlights: DeepSeek now commands 25.7% of tokens, up 1.4 points in 24 hours
Zhipu AI's GLM 5.3 sets new all-time high at 0.9% token share, debuts at rank 22
Anthropic's Claude 4.7 Opus jumps 19 ranks to #25 with 0.5% share
Google's Gemini 3.6 Flash surges 11 spots to rank 24 despite week-long slide
OpenAI drops 1.5 points to 10.4% as multiple models lose ground
Qwen's 3.8-27b enters at rank 49 with 0.2% share
